Entity.description: An entity with one text field.

Export Entity.description: An entity that other .bev files may import.

Import.description: Use exported entities of another .bev file.

Field.description: A field with a primitive type.

Optional Field.description: A field that may be empty.

Enum Field.description: A field with a fixed set of values and a default.

Rule.description: A validation rule: saves are refused when the condition is false.

Relationship Field.description: A reference to a record of another entity.

Owner Field.description: A reference to a signed-in account. Requires a top-level Identity block.

Identity.description: Sign-in with email and password, with self-service registration.

Role.description: A role for 'By <Role>'. Requires Identity; assign it with 'bever identity role add'.

Action.description: An action and who may perform it.

Owner Action.description: An action only the account in an owner field may perform.

Read Action.description: A read action with list order and picker search.

Picker.description: Who may choose records of an entity in relationship pickers.

Presentation.description: Labels, listing columns, and the editing experience of the generated app.
